page.title: Connected apps & API
page.subtitle: Use Stravica Social from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants, or from your own automations.
page.connectText: Your assistant reads your accounts, brand kit and results, writes drafts in your brand's voice and — only when you allow it — schedules posts and answers messages. You sign in with your Stravica account: no keys to copy. The assistant thinks and writes with your own subscription.
page.planLocked: Connecting AI assistants is included in the Pro plan and above.
page.copyFailed: Copying did not work: select the text and copy it.

claude: In Claude (web or desktop) open Settings › Connectors.
Choose “Add custom connector”, name it Stravica Social and paste the URL above.
Click Connect, sign in with your Stravica account, pick the workspace and what Claude may do.
chatgpt: In ChatGPT open Settings › Apps & Connectors (turn on developer mode under Advanced if your plan asks for it).
Create a connector: name it Stravica Social, paste the URL above and choose OAuth sign-in.
Sign in with your Stravica account, pick the workspace and what ChatGPT may do.
other: Add the URL as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) in your client.
It opens the Stravica sign-in by itself, or send a personal API key (below) as “Authorization: Bearer …”.

page.scopesNote: You choose these permissions when you connect. Publishing and the inbox are off unless you turn them on, and workspace approvals still apply.
page.appsEmptyText: Apps you connect appear here with what they may do. You can disconnect them at any time.
page.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {name}? It loses access right away.
page.keysText: For developers and automation tools (Zapier, n8n, your own scripts): send the key as “Authorization: Bearer …” to the MCP server URL. A key acts as you, with your role in this workspace.
page.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can manage API keys.
page.keyCreatedText: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
page.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key “{name}”? Tools that use it stop working.
